newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean yields end lower on better prospects.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean yields end lower on better prospects.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed lower on Monday as institutions, expecting flexible liquidity conditions in the near term, actively absorbed new supplies, brokers said.
They said the bullish sentiment was able to win over worries of a possible rebound after a sharp fall last week.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.88 vs 11.90 on Saturday
* Overnight average call rates at 11.70 vs 11.84
Three-month certificate of deposit (CD) yields and overnight call rates also dropped on improving liquidity conditions at financial institutions.
